zh.title: Archer 與迪士尼啟動航空研究合作 展示 Midnight 主題塗裝
zh.summary: Archer 與 Walt Disney Imagineering 研究團隊將探索未來交通概念，並在拉斯維加斯展示主題塗裝航空器。
body: 電動航空器開發商 Archer 宣佈，已與華特迪士尼幻想工程的研發團隊啟動合作，探索未來交通概念。雙方在拉斯維加斯一級方程式大獎賽活動期間對外展示合作。
Archer 在活動中展出採電影《復仇者聯盟：末日之戰》與迪士尼元素設計的 Midnight 航空器塗裝。Midnight 是 Archer 開發的電動垂直起降航空器。
這次公告的重點是研究合作及主題航空器展示。公告未公佈任何迪士尼載客服務的航線、收費或開航日期。

en.title: Archer and Disney Imagineering begin aviation research collaboration and show themed Midnight aircraft
en.summary: The companies announced research into future transportation concepts and presented a themed Midnight in Las Vegas.
body: Electric aircraft developer Archer announced a research collaboration with Walt Disney Imagineering’s research and development team to explore future transportation concepts. The companies presented the collaboration during the Formula One Las Vegas Grand Prix.
Archer displayed a Midnight electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft in a special livery featuring Disney branding and Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday.
The announcement covered the research collaboration and the display. It did not identify routes, ticket prices or a launch date for any Disney passenger service.

facts.claim: Archer and Walt Disney Imagineering announced a research collaboration on future transportation concepts.
The companies displayed a themed Midnight aircraft during the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
The aircraft carried Avengers: Doomsday and Disney branding.
